name: Ulm Minster: doors
_about: Ulm's doors: the main portal behind the tower's three-arched porch (two doorways either side of the trumeau with the Man of Sorrows), the aisles' west doors, the choir towers' doors, and the door of the great tower's stair turret.

doors._about: the main portal, from the porch into the nave
the great tower's stair, at its foot
